description:
Reid Original City | Commuter city bike

Durable, practical and built for everyday journeys – the ideal affordable commuter bike for getting to work, navigating city streets and making cycling part of your daily routine.

The Reid Original City is designed to offer a straightforward, reliable and affordable way to get around town. Built with everyday commuting in mind, it's an ideal choice for riders looking to swap driving or public transport for a practical alternative on two wheels.

Its custom steel frame and matching steel fork provide a durable foundation for regular urban riding, while 700 x 32C commuter tyres deliver a practical balance of comfort and efficiency on roads and city streets. Double-wall alloy rims add durability for everyday use, helping the Original City stand up to the demands of regular commuting.

A Shimano Tourney 7-speed drivetrain, combining a Revo shifter with a rear derailleur and a 42T single chainset, provides straightforward gearing for everyday journeys. The wide-range 14–34T freewheel offers flexibility for tackling moderate hills and varied urban routes, while the simple single-chainring setup keeps gear changes easy to manage.

Alloy V-brakes provide dependable stopping power for everyday city riding, while flat alloy handlebars and comfortable rubber grips offer a practical, easy-to-control riding position. A Reid city sport saddle adds comfort for regular journeys, and the included kickstand makes parking convenient when stopping at work, the shops or around town.

With its durable construction, straightforward gearing and practical components, the Original City keeps commuting simple and affordable. Whether you're heading to work, running errands or exploring your local area, it's a dependable way to make cycling part of your everyday routine.

The Original City is ideal for:

Everyday commuters, looking for an affordable and reliable way to travel to work or school

Urban and city riding, with 700 x 32C commuter tyres designed for everyday road use

Riders who value durability, with a custom steel frame and fork built for regular use

Simple, straightforward gearing, with a Shimano Tourney 7-speed drivetrain and single chainring for easy everyday riding

Commuters tackling moderate hills, with a 14–34T freewheel offering a useful range of gears for varied urban routes

Reliable everyday braking, with alloy V-brakes for controlled stopping around town

Practical daily transport, with double-wall alloy rims and a kickstand for convenient everyday use

Riders seeking an affordable first commuter bike, combining essential features with durable construction and practical value

Anyone looking to reduce car use, offering a practical alternative for commuting, shopping and shorter everyday journeys
